messages:
claire: Noticing odd behavior: endpoint /v1/generate p95 in prod-apac jumped ~220ms at 2024-09-02T07:41 after we nudged routing towards dedicated. No infra changes. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/diag.png
devin: I saw that too. Quick guess: sample-origin redistribution. We compute endpoint percentiles by merging per-route summaries; changing route weights can move the aggregate without any node regressions.
arjun: Also worth checking quotas: if hosted pool hit a soft quota and started shedding requests the sample composition changes -> endpoint pctl shifts. Can cause surprise.
emily: UX request: instead of a generic badge, what if the console surfaces a subtle "origin ribbon" above charts showing percent sample split (hosted 28% | dedicated 72%) and a small "why did p95 change?" link that opens a mini-modal explaining sample merge math.
claire: Love the ribbon concept. For alerts: our SLOs are bound to endpoint p95 today which caused an unnecessary oncall. We should recommend route-bound SLOs or a conservative alert mode that uses per-route max.
devin: API proposal: add `origin_mode` param to metrics API values: `merged` (current), `by_route_weighted`, `route_max`. Also add `include_origin_counts=true` which returns counts per route. That keeps compatibility while enabling conservative alerting.
arjun: For quotas we should add telemetry: when quota-induced reroutes occur, emit an event tag `sample_shift=quota_reroute` so console can show an annotation on the timeline. That helps quickly correlate pctl shifts to quota activity.
emily: I'll mock the ribbon and the mini-modal copy. Suggested copy: "Percentiles aggregated across routes. A change in routing or quota can change these numbers even if node latency is stable. Click to view route-level percentiles"
telemetry-bot: metric-alert: endpoint p95 exceeded threshold for /v1/generate (prod-apac) at 2024-09-02T07:43:12Z.
claire: Owners: devin -> API RFC for `origin_mode` + counts, arjun -> quota telemetry tags + backend events, emily -> ribbon + "why did p95 change" modal UX, claire -> update runbook + alerting guidance recommending route-level SLOs or `route_max` for safety. Can everyone aim to land canaries next deploy?
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: console-ribbon-canary -> 2024-09-03T01:30:00Z (includes ribbon + modal behind feature flag).
devin: I'll open RFC + tests. I'll include a synthetic that flips weights and asserts endpoint merged p95 moves while route p95s remain steady.
